title: Zesty Tunisian Millet Tagine
description: A savory, spicy one-pot millet dish packed with chickpeas, tomatoes, and a zesty harissa-tahini sauce, perfect for a quick vegan dinner.
instructions: Rinse the millet under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat the coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat and add the millet, stirring until lightly toasted.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
Stir in the chopped dried tomatoes, chickpeas, and a pinch of salt.
Add the harissa paste, lemon juice, and tahini, mixing well until the sauce coats the millet.
Gently fold in the fresh spinach until it wilts, about 3 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or lemon juice if desired.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with a drizzle of extra tahini and chopped parsley.
